name: MSP-Podcast: Large-Scale Naturalistic Speech Emotion Recognition Database
description: MSP-Podcast is a large-scale speech emotion database containing over 100,000 conversational speech segments extracted from naturalistic audio podcasts. Developed by the Multimodal Signal Processing (MSP) Lab at UT Dallas, it provides crowdsourced dimensional ratings (arousal, valence, dominance) and categorical emotion labels reflecting natural emotional variation.
